notes: 548 words with no section headers at all — the biggest single improvement available here.

decisions.label: Rebuild the heading outline
decisions.why: 5 headings sit at a level the page never opens — "General" is an h3 with no h2 above it, so it is neither announced nor styled as the sub-section it is. Each heading moves to one level below whatever encloses it.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 5 headings are plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Tag a document link with the format it opens
decisions.why: 44 links on this page open a file — 42 PDF, 1 Excel, 1 Word — and say nothing about it, while others in the same list carry a tag because their author typed one. The format is read from the file name, so the list stops being half-labelled. No link text changes.

decisions.label: Drop the dash once the link is set apart
decisions.why: 39 of those items separate the link from its description with a dash. The link is now set in the display face at a larger size with a chevron after it, so the dash marks a boundary that is already unmistakable. Only the separator is removed — no word changes.

decisions.label: Separate a link from its description
decisions.why: 39 list items open with a link and then explain it, all at the same weight — so the thing you can click is no easier to find than the sentence about it. The link becomes the item and the explanation sits under it.

decisions.label: Start a description with a capital
decisions.why: 1 description begins with a small letter, because it used to run on from the link after a dash. The dash is gone and the link now sits above in its own face, so each description opens a line of its own. One character changes and only ever the first.

decisions.label: Add a contents list (5 sections)
decisions.why: Built from the section headings already on the page. Below three sections a list is not a route.

mechanical: redundant bold inside a heading removed: 6
